themes_detail.label: Electrical hazards spike
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints surged to 5 this week versus a baseline of 0.4 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 1,233% spike—signaling a potential cluster of wiring, power, or infrastructure failures in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights that demands immediate investigation into whether a specific building or grid issue is creating safety risks.
evidence: 5 electrical complaints filed this week vs. 0.4 per week baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 6.65, indicating statistically significant deviation
reporting_angles: Interview Con Edison about emergency work orders or grid stress in CD 310 this week
Investigate geographic cluster: are complaints concentrated in one neighborhood block or building?

themes_detail.label: Building code violations surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints exploded to 66 three weeks ago—a 604% spike from the 9.4 weekly average—suggesting a concentrated enforcement action, new construction issue, or widespread code violations in residential or commercial properties that has not yet subsided.
evidence: 66 Building/Use complaints filed 3 weeks ago vs. 9.4 per week baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 15.01, highest statistical significance in dataset
Represents 604% spike; 444 total DOB filings in past 90 days with 24 new buildings in pipeline
reporting_angles: Cross-reference DOB permit data: did a major new building or renovation trigger compliance complaints?
Interview Department of Buildings about enforcement actions in Bay Ridge during that 3-week window

themes_detail.label: Dead animal collection crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints reached 17 last week—a 750% spike from the 2.0 weekly average—indicating a possible disease vector, sanitation failure, or pest infestation issue that poses public health concerns and warrants urgent sanitation response.
evidence: 17 dead animal complaints filed last week vs. 2.0 per week baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 6.71, indicating statistically significant spike
Represents 750% increase; Department of Sanitation garbage/recycling requests repeatedly in community board budget submissions
reporting_angles: Canvass neighborhoods where dead animals were reported: is there a specific area hotspot or rat infestation?
Interview DSNY about response time and whether they detected an unusual animal mortality event or pest surge

themes_detail.label: Illegal fireworks resurgence
themes_detail.summary: Illegal fireworks complaints jumped to 9 two weeks ago—a 929% spike from the 0.9 weekly average—suggesting organized or celebratory fireworks activity that may indicate coordinated illegal use or a community event gone unregulated.
evidence: 9 illegal fireworks complaints filed 2 weeks ago vs. 0.9 per week baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 7.71, indicating high statistical significance
Represents 929% spike; no recent community board or council constituent escalation data available to cross-check
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD about enforcement response and whether complaints map to a specific area or event (graduation, holiday, other celebration)
Canvass residents: were fireworks organized or sporadic? Any injuries or property damage reported outside 311 system?

themes_detail.label: Door/window damage cluster
themes_detail.summary: Door/Window complaints spiked to 19 last week—a 230% increase from the 5.8 weekly average—potentially indicating break-ins, weather damage, or vandalism affecting multiple residences and suggesting either a crime pattern or infrastructure vulnerability.
evidence: 19 door/window complaints filed last week vs. 5.8 per week baseline (8-week average)
Represents 230% spike; no corresponding NYPD crime data or community board escalations provided
reporting_angles: Cross-reference with NYPD burglary/robbery reports: is this a coordinated break-in trend or weather-related damage from last week's storms?
Interview residents: are complaints driven by break-ins, construction debris, or natural wear on aging buildings?
